fullTextZH: 你知道现在我是中文老师。
fullTextEN: You know now I am a Chinese teacher.

fullTextZH: 那你觉得以前我写的东西怎么样？
fullTextEN: So what do you think about what I wrote before?

fullTextZH: 所有的学生要写一个东西叫“作文”。
fullTextEN: All students have to write something called an "essay."
In elementary, middle, and high school,
We all have to write essays.
It also can't be too short.

fullTextZH: 那我写的作文怎么样呢？
fullTextEN: So how is the essay I wrote?

fullTextZH: 今天我要说说我写作文的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to talk about the story of writing my essay.
When I was in high school—
When I was in high school,

fullTextZH: 我的老师读给所有的人听。
fullTextEN: My teacher read it to everyone.

fullTextZH: 因为我的老师读我的作文——
fullTextEN: Because my teacher read my essay—
It's not that I wrote well,
It's that I didn't write well. Right, um...
At that time my teacher said:
"You all need to write an essay."

fullTextZH: 我写了很多不重要的东西：
fullTextEN: I wrote a lot of unimportant things:

fullTextZH: 很多很多不重要的东西。

fullTextEN: I know my writing is not good,

fullTextZH: 可是我不知道我可以写什么。对……
fullTextEN: But I don't know what I can write. Right...
So I gave it to the teacher—
This essay is not good. Okay,
The next day my teacher said:
"Today I want to read an essay,
"But I want to read it to you,

fullTextZH: 我要给你们看看为什么这篇作文不好。”
fullTextEN: I want to show you why this essay is not good."

fullTextZH: 我的老师没有说我的名字，
fullTextEN: My teacher didn't say my name,

fullTextZH: 我的老师没有说这篇作文是素清写的。
fullTextEN: My teacher didn't say this essay was written by Suqing.

fullTextZH: 别的人不知道是我写的，
fullTextEN: Other people don't know that I wrote it,
but I know that I wrote it.

fullTextZH: 我听我的老师读啊读啊，他说：
fullTextEN: I listened to my teacher reading and reading, he said:

fullTextZH: 可是我也觉得那个作文很难很难写。
fullTextEN: But I also think that essay was very hard to write.
then in the second year of high school,
the teacher read my essay again.

fullTextZH: 这一次我的作文又不好吗？
fullTextEN: Was my essay not good again this time?

fullTextZH: 这一次我的作文是最好的作文！
fullTextEN: This time my essay is the best essay!

fullTextZH: 所以我的老师读给所有的人听。
fullTextEN: So my teacher read it to everyone.

fullTextZH: 他要告诉所有的人为什么素清写的作文很好。
fullTextEN: He wanted to tell everyone why Suqing's essay was good.

fullTextZH: 因为在这篇作文，我写了一个人——
fullTextEN: Because in this essay, I wrote about a person—

fullTextZH: 这个人他的名字叫艾未未。
fullTextEN: This person, his name is Ai Weiwei.

fullTextZH: 他做了一件很奇怪的事：
fullTextEN: He did a very strange thing:
He was at Tiananmen in China,

fullTextZH: 他叫他的女朋友拉她的裙子……
fullTextEN: He asked his girlfriend to pull her skirt...
You can look at this photo.
At that time, I didn't understand,

fullTextZH: 我不明白为什么他做这个。
fullTextEN: I didn't understand why he did this.

fullTextZH: 我可以写在我的作文里。
fullTextEN: I can write it in my essay.

fullTextZH: 我的老师是一个中国的老师，
fullTextEN: My teacher is a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 这是第二次我的老师读我的作文。
fullTextEN: This is the second time my teacher has read my essay.

fullTextZH: 这一次所有的人知道是我写的。
fullTextEN: This time everyone knows it was written by me.

fullTextZH: 所有的人知道我写了一个很奇怪的例子。
fullTextEN: Everyone knows I wrote a very strange example.

fullTextZH: 所以以前我写了很多很多作文，
fullTextEN: So before, I wrote many, many essays,

fullTextZH: 可是我觉得那个时候，我每天学习很长很长时间——
fullTextEN: But I think at that time, I studied for a very, very long time every day—
I didn't have time to read books.

fullTextZH: 我觉得如果你要写很好的东西，
fullTextEN: I think if you want to write very good things,
you should read many, many books,

fullTextZH: 可是那个时候我没有时间看书。
fullTextEN: But at that time I didn't have time to read books.

fullTextZH: 我们常常写很多很多作文。
fullTextEN: We often write many, many essays.
Did you also write essays before?

fullTextZH: 老师读给所有的人听吗？
fullTextEN: Does the teacher read it to everyone?
Leave a comment and tell me!
